Established in 1999 by a former Oracle, executive Marc Benioff, Dave Moellenhoff, Parker Harris, and Frank Dominguez, Salesforce is one of the first international companies to deploy cloud-based CRM software successfully. Salesforce has been able to support cloud technology and establish a variety of apps for companies to assist in better ensure them key insights into their services via apps and analytics. Salesforce is regarded as the market leader in customer relationship management that has been the highlight in the world of marketing and sales of products and also with the services in many industries. In this technological era, companies can get individual client’s data with the intention to communicate with their respective clients on a large scale by using real-time message, and much more. This type of interaction with clients really assists companies in grasping their client’s wishes or needs in a better way, thereby they can serve them in the best manner only and also retain them in such a competitive world. Fact, Salesforce is one of the updated and advanced software, designed to fulfil the needs of the hiking up demands of every industry.
